fusions.name: Drowsy Sting
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm Settles
fusions.desc: Sends 3 clusters of bees at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it, and 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Passenger Hive
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second cast, wakes the hive you carry for 15 seconds: it stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Honey for Labour
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
